name: OpenAI Agents SDK SQLAlchemySession
description: Client-side conversation history for the OpenAI Agents SDK stored in any SQLAlchemy-supported database (extra 'sqlalchemy'). Scope is the application-chosen session_id.

provenance.notes: Supports version 0.24.0 (uploaded 2026-10-15) and the 'sqlalchemy' extra; the 0.24.0 wheel contains agents/extensions/memory/sqlalchemy_session.py.

Supports memory_type session (history across runs keyed by session_id; clear_session and pop_item) and backing_type relational ('SQLAlchemySession: For production apps using any SQLAlchemy-supported database'). TTL and encryption are only documented for the EncryptedSession wrapper and DaprSession, so supports_ttl and encryption_at_rest are omitted.
